trigger_events.source: Transcript 10:13-13:56: current liabilities rose QoQ from customer advances for sildenafil citrate in LatAm (at entry ~2016). 18:13: series of US FDA injectable approvals. Entry-time triggers, not current.

theme_evidence.source: Transcript 16:10-16:40: generic formulations sold through pharmacies in LatAm/Africa = repeat consumable demand.

value_chain_position.source: Transcript 15:22-16:47: reverse model - registers products demanded in LatAm/Africa registration markets via own pharmacy network and local partners; peers did not do this.
